fixed_versions:
For details on how to apply this update, which includes the changes described in this advisory, refer to:
https://images.redhat.com/
mitigations: Implement strict network egress filtering to allow outbound SSH/SFTP traffic only to known, trusted endpoints. Additionally, enforce strict SSH host key checking in your libssh2 client applications to reject unknown servers and prevent Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks.
